checks.title: Dos capas con capa débil en la base

warnings: negative-effective-normal: 9 slices of the critical surface have negative effective normal force (N′ < 0) at the base.

steep-entry-tension: The surface enters the slope at 90° and 9 slices on its steep part rely on tension at the base (N′ < 0 or a low m_α), which soil cannot take; the factor of safety is then unreliable (higher or lower than with the steep part cut off). A tension crack cutting off the steep part (Options › Crack at base angle, for example 60–70°) removes it.

notes: search: cSlope's own search (not ogs' grid); iterations taken from the ogs grid size (8000); minFailureDist = min_width (cSlope measures entry-exit distance).
